tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page ground of the landing page and the docs. Warm in light, GitHub canvas in dark. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, nav bar, code block frames: anything that sits on `paper` behind a `line` outline. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset wells inside a card: code block bodies, table stripes, the docs sidebar. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-water
tokens.usage: Full-bleed teal section band, and the fill of tip callouts. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it. Same value as `water-foam` in light; it exists so a band can stay a band when the foam shifts.

tokens.name: surface-crate
tokens.usage: Full-bleed warm section band, and the fill of pending callouts. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Every heading and every line of body copy, on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunk`, `surface-water` and `surface-crate`. From the mascot art, where it is the outline of Penny's face.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: captions, timestamps, the scan line, breadcrumb trails. Reads on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunk`, `surface-water` and `surface-crate`. From the mascot art's scaffolding grey.

tokens.name: ink-invert
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill: the inverted nav, the footer slab, ink-filled stickers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The comic outline. Every card, button, panel, input and code frame is drawn with it at `border-ink`. Reads on `paper`, `surface` and `surface-sunk`.

tokens.name: line-solid
tokens.usage: The outline on a bright fill (`crate`, `pending`, `failed`, `in-sync`, `water`) in BOTH themes, because those fills stay light in the dark theme. Decorative: the fill against `paper` carries the separation.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairline rules inside a card at `border-hair`: table rows, list separators, the gutter between docs columns. Decorative only, never a border that carries meaning.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: The channel. Big decorative fills: the wave rule, hero water, progress fill, the in-sync tint. Never a text ground unless the text is `on-water`. Exact from the mascot art.

tokens.name: water-deep
tokens.usage: The shaded trough under `water`: the lower wave band, link hover, icon strokes, and the hard shadow colour in the dark theme. As text or a mark it clears 3:1 on `paper` and `surface`, so use it at 24px+ or for marks, never for body copy. Exact from the mascot art.

tokens.name: water-foam
tokens.usage: Ripples and highlights on `water` and `water-deep`, and the fill of the tip sticker. Exact from the mascot art.

tokens.name: crate
tokens.usage: One crate is one pending stack. Large illustration fills, card top bars, underline swashes, icon fills. NOT a text ground: `ink` on it is only 4.02:1 in light. Put text on `crate-deep` instead. Exact from the mascot art.

tokens.name: crate-deep
tokens.usage: The crate's own outline in the art, and the fill of the primary button and of any warm chip carrying text. `on-crate-deep` reads on it. Exact from the mascot art.

tokens.name: on-crate-deep
tokens.usage: Label on a `crate-deep` fill: 6.95:1 in light, 4.90:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-water
tokens.usage: Label on a `water` or `water-foam` fill in either theme: 7.56:1 and 6.22:1 on `water`.

tokens.name: gate
tokens.usage: Penny's frame: the metal grey of dividers that want weight, the docs sidebar rail, disabled control fills. Reads as text on `paper` and `surface`. Exact from the mascot art.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The far bank behind Penny: decorative blocks, skeleton loaders, the empty half of a gauge, and the ground of a `planned` stage chip or an unticked checklist mark. Never text, never a meaningful border; `ink` reads on it where it carries a label. Exact from the mascot art.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Changes waiting behind the gate: the yellow count dot, the pending chip fill, the gauge marks, sticker fills. As a mark or 24px+ text it clears 3:1 on `paper` and `surface`; not for body copy. `on-pending` reads on it. Exact from the mascot art.

tokens.name: on-pending
tokens.usage: Label on a `pending` fill in either theme: 5.03:1 in light, 6.26:1 in dark.

tokens.name: deploying
tokens.usage: A stack is going through the gate: the blue count dot, the deploying chip, in-flight progress. Reads as text on `paper` and `surface`. Added for the site; the art has no blue.

tokens.name: on-deploying
tokens.usage: Label on a `deploying` fill: 5.19:1 in light, 6.25:1 in dark.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: A jam: the red count dot, failure lines, the destructive button fill, the blinking lamp. Reads as text on `paper` and `surface`. Exact from the mascot art's lamp and duck beak.

tokens.name: on-failed
tokens.usage: Label on a `failed` fill: 5.36:1 in light, 4.71:1 in dark.

tokens.name: in-sync
tokens.usage: Calm water: the green count dot, the in-sync chip, success ticks, the reeds on the bank. Reads as text on `paper` and `surface`. Exact from the mascot art's reeds.

tokens.name: on-in-sync
tokens.usage: Label on an `in-sync` fill: 5.08:1 in light, 6.22:1 in dark.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: The footer slab, and any band that stays dark in both themes. It does not flip, because the bottom of the page is the closed gate. `on-slab` reads on it.

tokens.name: on-slab
tokens.usage: Text and links on `slab`: 15.2:1 in light, 13.37:1 in dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, drawn OUTSIDE the control with a `paper` gap so it always lands on `paper` or `surface`: 15.2:1 and 16.02:1 there. Solid, never dashed.

families.sans: "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: shout
styles.usage: The one line at the top of the landing page. Never more than eight words, never two per page.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: Changes queue up behind the gate
styles.usage: Section openers on the landing page, and the h1 of a docs page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The h2 of a landing section and the h1 of a short docs page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Docs h2, and the heading inside a feature card.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Docs h4, callout titles, the title bar of a code block.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Sluiceway keeps one GitHub issue that shows which stacks have changes waiting.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a `shout` or `hero` line, and the lead of a docs page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The issue is a view and never the source of truth.
styles.usage: Every other paragraph and list item. The default.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, table cells, the scan line, footnotes. Set in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The smallest thing on the page: the sub line under the scan line, asset captions. Never for a whole sentence of importance.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercased in CSS. Eyebrow over a section, chip text, table headers, the stat under a count dot.

styles.name: sticker
styles.usage: The word on a tilted sticker and the label on a button. Not uppercased.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels at the default size.

styles.name: code-lead
styles.usage: The one copyable line a landing page shows in a frame.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Every code block and YAML sample in the docs.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Code inside a sentence, set in `crate-deep` on `surface-sunk`.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Stack ids and commit shas on a dashboard row, where a line must not wrap.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. The mascot art is drawn on the same grid: the crate is 76 x 66 and the gate posts are 14 wide.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The gap between a count dot and its number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, the gap between two stickers, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding-block, list item spacing, the gap inside a callout.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The default gap. Card padding on phones, paragraph spacing, code block padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button padding-inline at the default size.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on a desktop, the gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: The gap between a heading and the block under it, docs page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the blocks of a docs page.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between landing sections on a phone.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between landing sections on a desktop, and above the footer slab.

radius.note: Three of these are measured off the mascot art so a card and a crate round the same way.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Gate posts in the art; hairline chips and the tick box.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The gate's head rail in the art; inline code, small chips, table corners.

tokens.name: radius-crate
tokens.usage: The crate in the art, exactly. Buttons, stickers, count pills: anything crate-sized.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, code block frames, the nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels, the feature grid's outer frame, images with an ink outline.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Full-bleed section bands and the footer slab.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Speech bubbles, the scan line pill, avatar and dot shapes.

border.note: The comic outline. `border-ink` is the 2.4px stroke Penny's own outline is drawn with.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Rules inside a card, in `line-soft`. Decorative.

tokens.name: border-ink
tokens.usage: The default outline, in `line`: cards, buttons, inputs, chips, code frames. Exact from the mascot art.

tokens.name: border-bold
tokens.usage: Hero panels, the sticker outline, anything that must read from across the room.

tokens.name: border-slab
tokens.usage: The footer slab and full-bleed band edges only. One per page at most.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows, never blurred. The shadow is ink in the light theme and deep water in the dark theme, where an ink shadow would vanish into `paper`.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: A button while it is held down, and small chips. Pair it with a 2px translate so the control looks pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The default. Buttons at rest, cards, callouts, code frames, stickers.

tokens.name: shadow-pop-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels and the one card a section wants you to look at. At most one per screen.

tokens.name: shadow-pop-crate
tokens.usage: The warm variant, for a card that sits on `surface-water` where the ink shadow reads flat.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The only soft shadow: menus, popovers and the sticky nav once the page has scrolled. Nothing that sits still on the page gets it.

tilt.note: Rotations. Everything else on the page is square; these five are the whole budget, and no two neighbours get the same one.

tokens.name: tilt-none
tokens.usage: The default. Body text, nav, tables, code: never tilted.

tokens.name: tilt-left
tokens.usage: A card or panel that wants to look hand-placed. One or two per section.

tokens.name: tilt-right
tokens.usage: The neighbour of a `tilt-left` card, so the pair reads as scattered rather than skewed.

tokens.name: tilt-sticker
tokens.usage: Stickers and badges pinned to a corner.

tokens.name: tilt-shout
tokens.usage: A speech bubble coming off Penny, and nothing else.
